model.letu_bq_dbt.funnel_table_res.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized="incremental",
        partition_by={"field": "date"},
        incremental_strategy="insert_overwrite",
        on_schema_change="append_new_columns",
    )
}}

with
    result as (
        select
            r.event_date as date,
            `letual-143615.F.getChannel`(
                r.utm_source, r.utm_medium, r.utm_campaign
            ) as channel,
            `letual-143615.F.getArea`(
                r.utm_source, r.utm_medium, r.utm_campaign, r.utm_content, r.af_siteid
            ) as area,
            r.utm_source as source,
            r.utm_medium as medium,
            r.utm_campaign as campaign,
            r.utm_term as keyword,
            r.utm_content as adcontent,
            r.campaign_id as campaignid,
            g.ad_group_id as adgroupid,
            r.creative_id as creativeid,
            r.criteria_id as criteriaid,
            if(r.is_first_visit = '1', true, false) as newvisits,
            r.landing_page as landingpage,
            case
                when r.event_source = 'GA4' or r.crm_touchpoint = 'web'
                then 'web'
                when r.event_source in ('appsflyer', 'appsflyer_install') or r.crm_touchpoint = 'app'
                then 'app'
                when r.event_source is not null
                then 'other'
                else null
            end as touchpoint,
            r.event_source as old_touchpoint,
            r.device_category as devicecategory,
            r.browser,
            r.operating_system as operatingsystem,
            r.country,
            r.region,
            r.city,
            r.transaction_name as transaction_type,
            nullif(r.crm_touchpoint, "(not set)") as crm_touchpoint,
            nullif(r.crm_operatingsystem, "(not set)") as crm_operatingsystem,
            case
                when is_new = 'true' then '1'
                when is_new = 'false' then '0'
                else is_new
            end as crm_is_new,
            r.cost,
            r.impressions,
            r.clicks,
            r.events as sessions,
            yd_utm.account_name as account,
            r.af_prt,
            r.af_siteid,
            r.af_sub_siteid,
            r.sub,
            r.sub2,
            r.sub3,
            r.af_sub1,
            r.af_sub2,
            g.ad_group_name,
            r.value_lc as value_lpc,
            r.value_fc as value_fpc,
            r.value_ln as value_lnpc,
            r.revenue_lc as revenue_lpc,
            r.revenue_fc as revenue_fpc,
            r.revenue_ln as revenue_lnpc,
            r.revenue_without_discount_lc as revenue_without_discount_lpc,
            r.revenue_without_discount_ln as revenue_without_discount_lnpc,
            r.revenue_without_discount_fc as revenue_without_discount_fpc,
            r.offer_name
        from {{ ref("classic_report") }} as r
        left join {{ ref("int__yd_ad_group") }} as g
            on r.event_date = g.cost_date
            and r.utm_source = g.utm_source
            and r.utm_campaign = g.utm_campaign
            and r.utm_term = g.utm_term
            and r.utm_content = g.utm_content
        left join {{ ref("int__yd_ad_cost_utm")}} yd_utm
            on r.event_date = yd_utm.cost_date
            and r.utm_source = yd_utm.utm_source
            and r.utm_campaign = yd_utm.utm_campaign
        where {{ product.where('event_date', 'date') }}
    )

select * from result

        v.event_source as touchpoint,
        struct(
          v.device_category as deviceCategory,
          v.browser as browser,
          v.operating_system as operatingSystem,
          v.mobile_brand_name,
          cast(null as string) as ip
        ) as device,
        struct(
          v.country as country,
          v.region as region,
          v.city as city
        ) as geoNetwork,
        [struct(cast(null as string) as key, cast(null as string) as value)] as customDimensions,
        struct(
            v.utm_source,
            v.utm_medium,
            nullif(v.utm_campaign, "(not set)") as campaign,
            nullif(v.utm_term, "(not set)") as keyword,
            nullif(v.utm_content, "(not set)") as adcontent,
            ad_group.ad_group_name as adgroup,
            v.campaign_id as campaignid,
            ad_group.ad_group_id as adgroupid,
            v.creative_id as creativeid,
            v.criteria_id as criteriaid,
            'n/a' as gclid,
            'n/a' as dclid,
            'n/a' as yclid,
            'n/a' as fbclid,
            'n/a' as attributedadcost,
            'n/a' as _dbg_cost_attr_type
        ) as trafficsource,
        v.value_lc as value_lpc,
        v.value_fc as value_fpc,
        v.value_ln as value_lnpc,
        ce.crm_touchpoint,
        ce.crm_operatingsystem,
        ce.is_new as crm_is_new,
        ce.is_new_by_phone as crm_is_new_by_phone,
        ce.revenue_without_discount,
        v.operating_system_version as os_version,
        v.mobile_model_name as mobile_model,
        `letual-143615.F.getChannel`(
            v.utm_source, v.utm_medium, v.utm_campaign
        ) as channel,
        `letual-143615.F.getArea`(
            v.utm_source,
            v.utm_medium,
            v.utm_campaign,
            v.utm_content,
            v.utm_term
        ) as area,
        coalesce(e.sub, v.sub) as sub,
        coalesce(e.sub2, v.sub2) as sub2,
        coalesce(e.sub3, v.sub3) as sub3,
        coalesce(e.af_sub1, v.af_sub1) as af_sub1,
        coalesce(e.af_sub2, v.af_sub2) as af_sub2,
        coalesce(e.af_siteid, v.af_siteid) as af_siteid,
        coalesce(e.af_sub_siteid, v.af_sub_siteid) as af_sub_siteid,
        ce.user_id as npl,
        ce.crm_user_id
    from {{ ref("int__classic_value_attribution") }} as v
    left join {{ ref("int__yd_ad_group") }} as ad_group
            using(utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content)
    left join {{ ref("int__classic_transactions") }} as ce using(transaction_id)
    left join {{ ref("int__af_events") }} as e using(event_id)
    where {{ product.where("date(v.transaction_time)", "transaction_date") }}
)

model.letu_bq_dbt.int__flocktory_cost.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized="incremental",
        partition_by={"field": "cost_date"},
        incremental_strategy="insert_overwrite",
    )
}}

with
    cpo_flocktory as (
        select *
        from {{ ref("stg__flocktory_cost") }}
        where attribution = 'cpo'
    ),
    installs_blocked as (
        select
            coalesce(uids.user_id, installs.af_id) as user_id,
        from {{ ref("stg__af_installs_blocked") }} installs
        left join {{ ref("int__user_ids") }} as uids on installs.af_id = uids.id
    ),
    value_attribution as (
        select
            coalesce(uids.user_id, va.user_id) as user_id,
            event_id,
            event_date,
            utm_source,
            utm_medium,
            utm_campaign
        from {{ ref("int__classic_value_attribution") }} va
        left join {{ ref("int__user_ids") }} as uids on va.user_id = uids.id
        where
            {{ product.where("transaction_time", "transaction_time")}}
            and value_lc = 1
            and date(transaction_time)
                between event_date
                and date_add(
                    date_trunc(date_add(event_date, interval 1 month), month),
                    interval 9 day
                )  -- 10 число след.мес.
    ),
    joined as (
        select
            va.*,
            fc.fee,
            row_number() over (
                partition by va.event_id
                order by (fc.utm_campaign is not null) desc
            ) as match_utm_rank
        from value_attribution va
        join cpo_flocktory as fc
            on date(va.event_date) between fc.start_date and fc.end_date
            and fc.utm_source = va.utm_source
            and fc.utm_medium = va.utm_medium
            and (fc.utm_campaign = va.utm_campaign or fc.utm_campaign is null)
        left join installs_blocked on installs_blocked.user_id = va.user_id
        where installs_blocked.user_id is null
    ),
    result as (
        select
            event_id,
            event_date as cost_date,
            'Flocktory' as account_name,
            'Flocktory' as account_type,
            utm_source,
            utm_medium,
            utm_campaign,
            CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS utm_content,
            CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS utm_term,
            0 as impressions,
            0 as clicks,
            fee as cost,
            {{
                dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(
                    ["event_id", "event_date", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign"]
                )
            }} as cost_id
        from joined
        where match_utm_rank = 1
    )

select *
from result

model.letu_bq_dbt.int__crm_transactions.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized="table",
        partition_by={
            "field": "transaction_time",
            "granularity": "day",
            "data_type": "datetime",
        },
        on_schema_change="append_new_columns",
    )
}}
/* transaction_id String - уникальный идентификатор транзакции. Не должен повторяться во всем проекте.
user_id String - идентификатор пользователя. Это может быть client_id, номер телефона или любая строка, идентифицирующая пользователя. 
transaction_time DateTime - время транзакции.
transaction_name String - название транзакции. Например, call, purchase, opportunity.
transaction_source String */
select
    o.order_id as transaction_id,
    coalesce(o.user_id, o.crm_user_id) as user_id,
    o.order_time as transaction_time,
    "CRM" as transaction_name,
    "CRM" as transaction_source,
    o.revenue,
    o.revenue_without_discount,
    o.crm_touchpoint,
    o.crm_operatingsystem,
    o.is_new,
    o.is_new_by_phone,
    o.crm_user_id,
    a.offer_name,
    a.reward as cost
from {{ ref("stg__crm_orders") }} o
left join {{ ref("int__admon") }} a using (order_id)
qualify row_number() over (partition by transaction_id) = 1

model.letu_bq_dbt.int__crm_user_ids.name: int__crm_user_ids
model.letu_bq_dbt.int__crm_user_ids.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized="table",
        unique_key=["x", "y"],
        cluster_by=["x", "y"],
    )
}}
with
    data as (
        select order_id, crm_user_id, email_hash, phone_hash, clientndk
        from {{ ref("stg__crm_orders") }}
        where crm_user_id is not null and length(crm_user_id) > 0
    ),
    ids as (
        -- crm_user_id -> order_id
        select crm_user_id as x, order_id as y
        from data
        where order_id is not null and length(order_id) > 0

        union all

        -- crm_user_id -> email_hash
        select crm_user_id as x, email_hash as y
        from data
        where email_hash is not null and length(email_hash) > 0

        union all

        -- crm_user_id -> phone_hash
        select crm_user_id as x, phone_hash as y
        from data
        where phone_hash is not null and length(phone_hash) > 0

        union all

        -- crm_user_id -> clientndk
        select crm_user_id as x, clientndk as y
        from data
        where clientndk is not null and length(clientndk) > 0

    ),
    result as (select distinct x, y from ids)
select *
from result

model.letu_bq_dbt.int__af_events.name: int__af_events
model.letu_bq_dbt.int__af_events.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized="incremental",
        partition_by={"field": "event_date"},
        incremental_strategy="insert_overwrite",
        on_schema_change="sync_all_columns",
    )
}}

with
    /* 1) базовые события appsflyer за нужный период */
    events_base as (
        select
            appsflyer_id,
            time as event_timestamp,
            event_name,
            event_time,
            date,
            attributed_touch_time,
            af_c_id,
            is_retargeting
        from {{ ref("stg__af_events_parsed") }}
        where {{ product.where("date", "event_date") }}
        qualify row_number() over (
            partition by date, appsflyer_id, event_time, event_name, is_retargeting
            order by attributed_touch_time desc
        ) = 1
    ),

    /* 1.1 фильтрация ретаргетинга */
    retargeting as (
        select
            *,
            if(
                count(appsflyer_id) over (partition by appsflyer_id, event_time, event_name) > 1,
                'true',
                'false'
            ) as is_cnt_ret
        from events_base
    ),
    retargeting_filtered as (
        select appsflyer_id, event_timestamp, event_name, af_c_id
        from retargeting
        where (is_cnt_ret='true' and is_retargeting='true') or is_cnt_ret='false'
        qualify row_number() over (partition by date, appsflyer_id, event_time order by attributed_touch_time desc) = 1
    ),

    /* 2) предыдущее событие внутри клиента (для разбиения на сессии) */
    events_with_prev as (
        select
            *,
            lag(event_timestamp) over (
                partition by appsflyer_id order by event_timestamp
            ) as prev_event_timestamp
        from retargeting_filtered
    ),

    /* 3) помечаем начала сессий (разрыв > 30 минут или первое событие) */
    sessions_counted as (
        select
            *,
            case
                when
                    prev_event_timestamp is null
                    or datetime_diff(event_timestamp, prev_event_timestamp, minute) > 30
                    or event_name='re-engagement'
                then concat(event_name, cast(event_timestamp as string), appsflyer_id)
                else null
            end as raw_session_id
        from events_with_prev
    ),
    sessions_flagged as (
        select
            *,
            COUNTIF(raw_session_id is not NULL) over (
                partition by appsflyer_id
                order by event_timestamp
                rows between UNBOUNDED PRECEDING and CURRENT ROW
            ) as session_group
        from sessions_counted
    ),

    /* 4) нумеруем группы сессий и протягиваем id начала до всех событий сессии */
    sessions_filled as (
        select
            *,
            countif(raw_session_id is not null) over (
                partition by appsflyer_id
                order by event_timestamp
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as session_group,
            max(raw_session_id) over (
                partition by appsflyer_id, session_group
                order by event_timestamp
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as session_id
        from sessions_flagged
    ),

    /* 5) границы каждой сессии (старт/финиш) */
    session_windows as (
        select
            appsflyer_id,
            session_id,
            min(event_timestamp) as min_session_time,
            max(event_timestamp) as max_session_time
        from sessions_filled
        group by appsflyer_id, session_id
    ),

    /* 6) стартовые события сессий (ровно одно событие на сессию) */
    session_starts as (
        select
            f.appsflyer_id,
            f.event_timestamp as session_time,
            f.session_id,
            f.af_c_id,
            w.min_session_time,
            w.max_session_time
        from sessions_filled as f
        join
            session_windows as w
            on f.session_id = w.session_id
            and f.appsflyer_id = w.appsflyer_id
        where f.event_timestamp = w.min_session_time
    ),

    /* 7) приводим сессии к целевой схеме фактов */
    sessions_facts as (
        select distinct
            session_time,
            appsflyer_id,
            session_id,
            af_c_id,
            min_session_time,
            max_session_time
        from session_starts
    ),

    /* 8) время предыдущей сессии клиента (для границ атрибуции) */
    sessions_with_prev_time as (
        select
            s.*,
            lag(s.session_time) over (
                partition by s.appsflyer_id order by s.session_time
            ) as previous_session_time
        from sessions_facts as s
    ),

    /* 9) источники трафика (сырые события источников) */
    source_events as (
        select
            s.appsflyer_id,
            s.media_source,
            s.campaign,
            s.content,
            s.af_keywords,
            s.attributed_touch_time,
            s.device_category,
            s.platform,
            s.af_prt,
            s.af_siteid,
            s.af_sub_siteid,
            s.af_sub1,
            s.af_sub2,
            s.sub,
            s.sub2,
            s.sub3
        from {{ ref("int__af_sources") }} as s
    ),

    /* 10) источники в окне (prev_session_time; session_start] и выбор последнего */
    candidate_sources as (
        select
            t.session_id,
            s.media_source,
            s.campaign,
            s.content,
            s.af_keywords,
            s.attributed_touch_time,
            s.device_category,
            s.platform,
            s.af_prt,
            s.af_siteid,
            s.af_sub_siteid,
            s.af_sub1,
            s.af_sub2,
            s.sub,
            s.sub2,
            s.sub3,
            row_number() over (
                partition by t.session_id order by s.attributed_touch_time desc
            ) as rn
        from sessions_with_prev_time as t
        left join
            source_events as s
            on t.appsflyer_id = s.appsflyer_id
            /* нижняя граница: после предыдущей сессии, либо "эпоха" для первой */
            and datetime(s.attributed_touch_time)
            > coalesce(t.previous_session_time, datetime '1970-01-01 00:00:00')
            /* верхняя граница: не позже старта текущей сессии */
            and datetime(s.attributed_touch_time) <= t.min_session_time
    ),

    /* 11) обогащённые сессии — подтягиваем лучший источник (rn=1) */
    result as (
        select
            'appsflyer' as event_source,
            timestamp(p.session_time) as event_time,
            date(p.session_time) as event_date,
            p.session_id as event_id,

with
    datas as (
        select distinct
            s.time,
            s.date,
            s.appsflyer_id,
            s.af_c_id,
            s.hitid as event_id,
            0 as cost,
            ib.af_id is not null as cpi_blocked
        from {{ ref("stg__af_events_parsed") }} as s
        left join
            {{ ref("stg__af_installs_blocked") }} as ib
            on ib.af_id = s.appsflyer_id
            and ib.date = s.date
        where
            {{ product.where("s.date", "date") }}
            and s.event_name in ('install', 'reinstall')

    ),
    source_matched as (
        -- Find the most recent source before the current transaction
        select
            appsflyer_id,
            media_source,
            campaign,
            af_keywords,
            content,
            attributed_touch_time as source_time,
            device_category,
            platform,
            af_prt,
            af_siteid,
            af_sub_siteid,
            af_sub1,
            af_sub2,
            sub,
            sub2,
            sub3
        from {{ ref("int__af_sources") }} s
    ),
    filtered_sources as (
        -- Filter sources so they fall  current transactions
        select
            s.*,
            t.event_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() over (
                partition by t.event_id order by s.source_time DESC
            ) as rn
        from datas t
        left join
            source_matched s
            on t.appsflyer_id = s.appsflyer_id
            and datetime(s.source_time) <= t.time  -- Before or at the current transaction
    ),
    get_utm_sources as (
        select
            p.*,
            s.device_category,
            s.platform,
            s.af_prt,
            s.af_siteid,
            s.af_sub_siteid,
            s.af_sub1,
            s.af_sub2,
            s.sub,
            s.sub2,
            s.sub3,
            coalesce(s.media_source, '(direct)') as utm_source,
            if(s.media_source is null, '(none)', 'appsflyer') as utm_medium,
            coalesce(s.campaign, '') as utm_campaign,
            coalesce(s.af_keywords, '') as utm_term,
            coalesce(s.content, '') as utm_content,
        from datas as p
        left join filtered_sources s on p.event_id = s.event_id and s.rn = 1  -- Pick the closest source before purchase
    ),

    cpi_cost as (
        select
            data.* replace (data.cost + if(cpi_blocked, 0, ifnull(c.cost, 0)) as cost)
        from get_utm_sources as data
        left join
            {{ source("sheets", "cpi_cost") }} as c
            on lower(data.platform) = lower(c.platform)
            and lower(data.utm_source) = lower(c.source)
            and lower(data.utm_campaign) = lower(c.campaign)
            and date_trunc(data.date, month) = date(c.month)
    ),
    flocktory_cost as (

        select data.* replace (data.cost + if(cpi_blocked, 0, ifnull(c.fee, 0)) as cost)
        from cpi_cost as data
        left join
            {{ ref("stg__flocktory_cost") }} as c
            on lower(data.utm_source) = lower(c.utm_source)
            and lower(data.utm_medium) = lower(c.utm_medium)
            and date between c.start_date and c.end_date
            and c.attribution = "cpi"
    ),
    result as (
        select
            'appsflyer_install' as event_source,
            time as event_time,
            date as event_date,
            event_id,
            appsflyer_id as user_id,
            coalesce(af_c_id, '') as af_c_id,
            utm_source,
            utm_medium,

            utm_term,
            utm_content,

            coalesce(device_category, '') as device_category,
            coalesce(platform, '') as platform,
            coalesce(af_prt, '') as af_prt,
            coalesce(af_siteid, '') as af_siteid,
            coalesce(af_sub_siteid, '') as af_sub_siteid,
            coalesce(af_sub1, '') as af_sub1,
            coalesce(af_sub2, '') as af_sub2,
            coalesce(sub, '') as sub,
            coalesce(sub2, '') as sub2,
            coalesce(sub3, '') as sub3
        from flocktory_cost

    )

{% set processing_interval = product.get_processing_interval("event_date", calc_depth=1) %}
with
    event_ids as (
        select
            user_pseudo_id,
            coalesce(
                if(
                    device.advertising_id = ''
                    or device.advertising_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
                    or device.advertising_id = '0000-0000',
                    null,
                    device.advertising_id
                ),
                if(device.vendor_id = '', null, device.vendor_id)
            ) as device_id,
            (
                select
                    coalesce(ep.value.string_value, cast(ep.value.int_value as string))
                from unnest(event_params) as ep
                where
                    ep.key = 'order_id'
                    and event_name in (
                        'purchase',
                        'ecommerce_checkout',
                        'click_purchase',
                        'purchase_failed',
                        'click_begin_checkout',
                        'click_to_order',
                        'click_purchase_failed',
                        'thank_you_page_open',
                        'ecommerce_purchase_failed'
                    )
            ) as order_id,
            concat(
                '0x',
                UPPER(
                    to_hex(
                        sha256(
                            (
                                select ep.value.string_value
                                from unnest(event_params) as ep
                                where ep.key = 'email'
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) as email,
            concat(
                '0x',
                UPPER(
                    to_hex(
                        sha256(
                            concat(
                                7,
                                regexp_extract(
                                    regexp_replace(
                                        (
                                            select
                                                coalesce(
                                                    ep.value.string_value,
                                                    cast(ep.value.int_value as string),
                                                    cast(
                                                        cast(
                                                            ep.value.float_value
                                                            as integer
                                                        ) as string
                                                    )
                                                )
                                            from unnest(event_params) as ep
                                            where ep.key in ('phone_number', 'phone')
                                        ),
                                        r'[^\d]',
                                        ''
                                    ),
                                    r'\d{10}$'
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) as phone,
            coalesce(
                (
                    select
                        coalesce(
                            ep.value.string_value,
                            cast(ep.value.int_value as string),
                            cast(cast(ep.value.float_value as integer) as string)
                        )
                    from unnest(event_params) as ep
                    where ep.key = 'discount_card_id'
                ),
                (
                    select
                        coalesce(
                            up.value.string_value, cast(up.value.int_value as string)
                        )
                    from unnest(user_properties) as up
                    where up.key = 'loyalty_card'
                )
            ) as discount_card_id,
            user_id,
            timestamp_micros(event_timestamp) as event_timestamp
        from {{ source("ga4", "events") }}
        where
            {% if processing_interval["is_updated"] %} false
            {% else %}
                _TABLE_SUFFIX between format_date(
                    '%Y%m%d', date('{{ processing_interval["from"] }}')
                ) and format_date('%Y%m%d', date('{{ processing_interval["to"] }}'))
            {% endif %} and user_pseudo_id is not NULL
    ),
    data as (
        select user_pseudo_id as x, user_id as y, date(event_timestamp) as event_date
        from event_ids
        where user_id is not null and length(user_id) > 0

        union all
        select user_pseudo_id as x, device_id as y, date(event_timestamp) as event_date
        from event_ids
        where device_id is not null and length(device_id) > 0
        union all
        select user_pseudo_id as x, phone as y, date(event_timestamp) as event_date
        from event_ids
        where phone is not null and length(phone) > 0
        union all
        select user_pseudo_id as x, email as y, date(event_timestamp) as event_date
        from event_ids
        where email is not null and length(email) > 0
        union all
        select
            user_pseudo_id as x,
            discount_card_id as y,
            date(event_timestamp) as event_date
        from event_ids
        where discount_card_id is not null and length(discount_card_id) > 0
        union all
        select user_pseudo_id as x, order_id as y, date(event_timestamp) as event_date
        from event_ids
        where order_id is not null and length(order_id) > 0
    ),
    result as (
        select distinct x, y, max(event_date) as event_date from data group by 1, 2
    )
select *
from result

with
    /* ============================
       1) format_hit
       ----------------------------
       Нормализуем событие уровня "хит":
       - Вычисляем UTM-метки через функцию holoway.F_US.ga4_get_traffic_v172(...)
       - Генерим surrogate hitId
       - Определяем event_number (порядок событий пользователя)
       - Высчитываем surrogate session_id, если 'ga_session_id' отсутствует
       - Помечаем вход/выход в рамках пары (user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id)
       - Отфильтровываем мобильные платформы и технич. события
       ============================ */
    format_hit as (
        select
            GENERATE_UUID() as hitId,
            `letual-gcp-apps.F.url_decode`(
                regexp_extract(
                    (select p.value.string_value from unnest(event_params) p where p.key='page_location' limit 1),
                    r"https?://[^/]+(.*)"
                )
            ) as page_path,
            device.category as device_category,
            device.web_info.browser as browser,
            device.operating_system as operating_system,
            device.operating_system_version as operating_system_version,
            device.mobile_brand_name,
            device.mobile_model_name,
            geo.country as country,
            geo.region as region,
            geo.city as city,
            -- Разбор источников/UTM из event_params + collected_traffic_source
            `letual-gcp-apps.F.ga4_get_traffic_v172`(
                event_params,
                STRUCT(
                    collected_traffic_source.manual_campaign_id,
                    collected_traffic_source.manual_campaign_name,
                    collected_traffic_source.manual_source,
                    collected_traffic_source.manual_medium,
                    collected_traffic_source.manual_term,
                    collected_traffic_source.manual_content,
                    collected_traffic_source.gclid,
                    collected_traffic_source.dclid,
                    collected_traffic_source.srsltid
                ),
                app_info.install_source,
                false  -- флаг доп. логики (оставлено как в исходном коде)
            ) as url_utms,

            user_pseudo_id,

            -- Порядковый номер события пользователя по времени
            ROW_NUMBER() over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id order by event_timestamp
            ) as event_number,

            -- event_date в DATE
            parse_date("%Y%m%d", event_date) as event_date,

            -- Суррогатный session_id: ga_session_id, иначе LAG(ga_session_id), иначе
            -- event_timestamp
            CONCAT(
                user_pseudo_id,
                "_",
                COALESCE(
                    (
                        select p.value.int_value
                        from unnest(event_params) p
                        where p.key = 'ga_session_id'
                        limit 1
                    ),
                    LAG(
                        (
                            select p.value.int_value
                            from unnest(event_params) p
                            where p.key = 'ga_session_id'
                            limit 1
                        )
                    ) over (
                        partition by user_pseudo_id order by e.event_timestamp DESC
                    ),
                    event_timestamp
                )
            ) as session_id,

            -- Порядковый номер визита GA4
            (
                select p.value.int_value
                from unnest(event_params) p
                where p.key = 'ga_session_number'
                limit 1
            ) as visit_number,

            -- Секунды вовлеченности из GA4 (в мс)
            (
                select p.value.int_value
                from unnest(event_params) p
                where p.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
                limit 1
            ) as engagement_time_msec,

            -- Флаг "вход" в сессию: самое раннее page_view или, если нет, самое
            -- раннее событие
            IF(
                ROW_NUMBER() over (
                    partition by
                        user_pseudo_id,
                        (
                            select p.value.int_value
                            from unnest(event_params) p
                            where p.key = 'ga_session_id'
                            limit 1
                        )
                    order by (IF(event_name = 'page_view', 1, 0)) DESC, event_timestamp
                )
                = 1,
                1,
                0
            ) as is_entrance,

            -- Флаг "выход" из сессии: самое позднее page_view или, если нет, самое
            -- позднее событие
            IF(
                ROW_NUMBER() over (
                    partition by
                        user_pseudo_id,
                        (
                            select p.value.int_value
                            from unnest(event_params) p
                            where p.key = 'ga_session_id'
                            limit 1
                        )
                    order by
                        (IF(event_name = 'page_view', 1, 0)) DESC, event_timestamp DESC
                )
                = 1,
                1,
                0
            ) as is_exit,

            -- Метка времени события (MICROS -> TIMESTAMP)
            timestamp_micros(event_timestamp) as event_timestamp,

            -- Название события
            event_name,

            -- Платформа (web / ANDROID / IOS)
            platform

        from {{ table_ref }} as e
        where
            {% if processing_interval["is_updated"] %} false
            {% else %}
                _TABLE_SUFFIX between format_date(
                    '%Y%m%d', date('{{ processing_interval["from"] }}')
                ) and format_date('%Y%m%d', date('{{ processing_interval["to"] }}'))
            {% endif %} and user_pseudo_id is not NULL
            {% for event_filter in var("events", {}).get("ga4", {}).get(
                "event_filters", []
            ) %} and {{ event_filter }} {% endfor %}
    ),

    /* ============================
       2) session_groups
       ----------------------------
       - Считаем hash источника (source/medium/campaign/gclid) => traffic_source_id
       - Внутри (clientId, sessionId) считаем признак "встречался ли НЕ direct" —
         на основе кумулятивной суммы по hit_number (ожидаются поля clientId, sessionId, hit_number)
       ============================ */
    session_groups as (
        select
            FARM_FINGERPRINT(
                CONCAT(
                    IFNULL(url_utms.source, ""),
                    IFNULL(url_utms.medium, ""),
                    IFNULL(url_utms.campaign, ""),
                    IFNULL(url_utms.gclid, "")
                )
            ) as traffic_source_id,

            -- "Сессийная" группа по встрече НЕ-direct источника внутри (clientId,
            -- sessionId)
            sum(if(NULLIF(url_utms.source, "(direct)") is not null, 1, 0)) over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id, session_Id order by event_number
            ) as session_group,

            *
        from format_hit
    ),

    /* ============================
       3) session_groups_merge
       ----------------------------
       - Если session_group=0 и таких хитов <5, принудительно относим их к группе 1
         (защита от "коротких" direct-хвостов)
       ============================ */
    session_groups_merge as (
        select
            if(
                session_group = 0
                and count(1) over (
                    partition by user_pseudo_id, session_id, session_group
                )
                < 5,
                1,
                session_group
            ) as session_group,
            * except (session_group)
        from session_groups
    ),

    /* ============================
       4) traffic_source1
       ----------------------------
       - Берём первый НЕ-direct url_utms и traffic_source_id в пределах (clientId, sessionId, session_group)
       - Используем FIRST_VALUE ... IGNORE NULLS
       ============================ */
    traffic_source1 as (
        select
            first_value(
                IF(
                    url_utms.source is NULL or url_utms.source = "(direct)",
                    NULL,
                    url_utms
                ) IGNORE NULLS
            ) over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id, session_id, session_group
                order by event_number
                rows between UNBOUNDED PRECEDING and UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
            ) as url_utms,

            first_value(
                IF(
                    url_utms.source is NULL or url_utms.source = "(direct)",
                    NULL,
                    traffic_source_id
                ) IGNORE NULLS
            ) over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id, session_id, session_group
                order by event_number
                rows between UNBOUNDED PRECEDING and UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
            ) as traffic_source_id,

            * except (url_utms, traffic_source_id)
        from session_groups_merge
    ),

    /* ============================
       5) same_sessions
       ----------------------------
       - Группируем последовательные хиты одного clientId по одинаковому traffic_source_id
         (DENSE_RANK по traffic_source_id -> rank_group)
       ============================ */
    same_sessions as (
        select
            DENSE_RANK() over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id order by traffic_source_id
            ) as rank_group,
            *
        from traffic_source1
    ),

    /* ============================
       6) timeout_check
       ----------------------------
       - Проверяем разрывы по времени между хитами в рамках (clientId, rank_group)
       - Если разрыв > 30 минут — ставим флаг real_session_change
       ============================ */
    timeout_check as (
        select
            event_timestamp as cur_time,
            LAG(event_timestamp) over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id, rank_group order by event_number
            ) as lag_time,

            IF(
                TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
                    event_timestamp,
                    LAG(event_timestamp) over (
                        partition by user_pseudo_id, rank_group order by event_number
                    ),
                    MINUTE
                )
                > 30,
                1,
                0
            ) as real_session_change,

            *
        from same_sessions
    ),

    /* ============================
       7) real_session_groups
       ----------------------------
       - Нарастающая сумма real_session_change -> real_session_group
         (дробим rank_group на реальные сессии по таймауту)
       ============================ */
    real_session_groups as (
        select
            SUM(real_session_change) over (
                partition by user_pseudo_id, rank_group order by event_number
            ) as real_session_group,
            *
        from timeout_check
    ),

    /* ============================
       8) sessions
       ----------------------------
       - Агрегируем хиты в сессии:
         * собираем user/device/geo/customDimensions
         * считаем метрики totals, totalsStreaming
         * помечаем isTrueDirect (все хиты direct?)
         * строим sessionId на базе clientId, min(timestamp), rank_group, real_session_group
       ============================ */
    sessions as (
        select
            -- Выбираем один user (приоритет покупочного/возвратного события)
            MIN(event_date) as event_date,
            MIN(event_timestamp) as event_time,
            user_pseudo_id as user_id,

            CONCAT(
                user_pseudo_id,
                "_",
                min(event_timestamp),
                "_",
                rank_group,
                "_",
                real_session_group
            ) as event_id,

            -- Bounce-логика по engagement_time (<=15 сек — bounce)
            case
                when sum(engagement_time_msec) / 1000 > 15 then 0 else 1
            end as is_bounce,

            MAX(platform) as platform,
            struct(
                any_value(url_utms.source) as utm_source,
                any_value(url_utms.medium) as utm_medium,
                any_value(url_utms.campaign) as utm_campaign,
                any_value(url_utms.keyword) as utm_keyword,
                any_value(url_utms.adContent) as utm_content,

                any_value(url_utms.campaignId) as campaign_id,
                any_value(url_utms.campaignName) as campaign_name,
                any_value(url_utms.adGroupId) as ad_group_id,
                any_value(url_utms.creativeId) as creative_id,
                any_value(url_utms.criteriaId) as criteria_id
            ) as traffic_source,
            any_value(browser) as browser,
            any_value(device_category) as device_category,
            any_value(operating_system) as operating_system,
            any_value(operating_system_version) as operating_system_version,
            any_value(mobile_brand_name) as mobile_brand_name,
            any_value(mobile_model_name) as mobile_model_name,
            any_value(country) as country,
            any_value(region) as region,
            any_value(city) as city,
            array_agg(
                split(page_path, "?")[safe_offset(0)]
                ignore nulls
                order by if(event_name = 'page_view', 1, 0) desc, event_number
            )[safe_offset(0)] as landing_page,
            cast(
                max(if(event_name="first_visit", '1', '')) as string
            ) as is_first_visit
        from real_session_groups
        group by user_pseudo_id, rank_group, real_session_group
    ),

    /* ============================
       9) history_sessions
       ----------------------------
       - Объединяем текущие сессии (sessions) с историческими данными из int__ga4_events
       - Приводим структуру traffic_source к единому виду (STRUCT)
       - Считаем session_group:
           * кумулятивная сумма по пользователю
           * увеличивается каждый раз, когда встречается НЕ-direct источник
       - Это нужно, чтобы:
           → разбить историю пользователя на "цепочки атрибуции"
           → корректно искать предыдущий НЕ-direct источник
    ============================ */
    history_sessions as (
        select
            *,
            sum(
                if(traffic_source.utm_source is not null and traffic_source.utm_source!='(direct)', 1, 0)
            ) over(partition by user_id order by event_time) as session_group
        from (
            select
                user_id,
                event_id,
                datetime(event_time) as event_time,
                traffic_source
            from sessions
            {% if is_incremental() %}
                union all
                select
                    user_id,
                    event_id,
                    event_time,
                    STRUCT(
                        utm_source,
                        utm_medium,
                        utm_campaign,
                        utm_keyword,
                        utm_content,
                        campaign_id,
                        campaign_name,
                        ad_group_id,
                        creative_id,
                        criteria_id
                    ) as traffic_source
              from {{ this }}
              where event_date between
                    date_sub('{{ processing_interval["from"] }}', interval 180 day) and
                    date_sub('{{ processing_interval["from"] }}', interval 1 day)
            {% endif %}
        )
    ),

    /* ============================
       10) previous_traffic_sources
       ----------------------------
       - Для каждой session_group берём первый НЕ-direct источник
       - По сути:
           → определяем "источник цепочки"
           → это и есть кандидат на наследование (inherit)
       - На выходе:
           * event_id текущей сессии
           * prev_source — источник, который нужно подставить при direct
       ============================ */
    previous_traffic_sources as (
        select
            first_value(traffic_source) over(partition by user_id, session_group order by event_time) as prev_source,
            event_id
        from history_sessions
    ),
    /* ============================
       11) traffic_inherit
       ----------------------------
       - Реализуем логику наследования источника:
           1. Если в текущей сессии source НЕ direct → оставляем как есть
           2. Если direct/NULL → подставляем предыдущий НЕ-direct источник (prev_source)
           3. Иначе оставляем direct
       * наследуется вся структура traffic_source (не только source/medium)
       ============================ */
    traffic_inherit AS(
        select
            s.* except(traffic_source),
            /*array( (select as struct key, value from (select key, first_value(value) over(PARTITION BY key ORDER BY time DESC) as value from unnest(customDimensions) where value is not null) group by key,value) ) as customDimensions,*/
            case
                when s.traffic_source.utm_source is not null and s.traffic_source.utm_source!='(direct)'
                    then s.traffic_source
                when (s.traffic_source.utm_source is null OR s.traffic_source.utm_source='(direct)') AND (previous_traffic_sources.prev_source.utm_source is not null AND previous_traffic_sources.prev_source.utm_source!='(direct)')
                    then previous_traffic_sources.prev_source
                else s.traffic_source
            end as traffic_source
        from sessions s
        left join previous_traffic_sources using(event_id)
    ),
    result as (

        /* ============================
   12) Финальный SELECT
   ----------------------------
   - Нормализуем source/medium:
     * yandex.ru / referral -> source=yandex, medium=organic
     * NULL -> (direct)/(none)
   - Возвращаем те же поля, но с заменённым trafficSource
   ============================ */
        select
            'GA4' as event_source,
            traffic_source.utm_campaign as utm_campaign,
            traffic_source.utm_keyword as utm_keyword,
            traffic_source.utm_content as utm_content,
            case
                when traffic_source.utm_source = 'yandex.ru' and traffic_source.utm_medium = 'referral'
                then 'yandex'
                when traffic_source.utm_source is NULL or traffic_source.utm_source = ''
                then '(direct)'
                else traffic_source.utm_source
            end as utm_source,

            case
                when traffic_source.utm_source = 'yandex.ru' and traffic_source.utm_medium = 'referral'
                then 'organic'
                when traffic_source.utm_medium is NULL or traffic_source.utm_medium = ''
                then '(none)'
                else traffic_source.utm_medium
            end as utm_medium,

            {% for dimension in var("events", {}).get("extra_dimensions", []) %}
                {{ dimension["value"] }} as {{ dimension["name"] }},
            {% endfor %}

            * except (
                traffic_source,
                landing_page,
                is_first_visit,
                device_category,
                browser,
                operating_system,
                operating_system_version,
                mobile_brand_name,
                mobile_model_name,
                country,
                region,
                city
            )
            replace(
                {%- if adapter.type() == "clickhouse" -%}
                    toTimeZone(assumeNotNull(event_time), '{{ timezone }}') as event_time
                {%- elif adapter.type() == "bigquery" -%}
                    datetime(event_time, '{{ timezone }}') AS event_time
                {% endif %}
            ),

        from traffic_inherit
    )

-- one record for each resource in the graph and its direct parent
with

    all_graph_resources as (
        select
            resource_id,
            resource_name,
            resource_type,
            file_path,
            directory_path,
            file_name,
            model_type,
            materialized,
            is_public,
            access,
            source_name,
            is_excluded
        from {{ ref("int_all_graph_resources") }}
    ),

    direct_model_relationships as (
        select resource_id, direct_parent_id, is_primary_relationship
        from {{ ref("stg_node_relationships") }}
    ),

    direct_exposure_relationships as (
        select resource_id, direct_parent_id, is_primary_relationship
        from {{ ref("stg_exposure_relationships") }}
    ),

    direct_metrics_relationships as (
        select resource_id, direct_parent_id, is_primary_relationship
        from {{ ref("stg_metric_relationships") }}
    ),

    -- for all resources in the graph, find their direct parent
    direct_relationships as (
        select
            all_graph_resources.resource_id as resource_id,
            all_graph_resources.resource_name as resource_name,
            all_graph_resources.resource_type as resource_type,
            all_graph_resources.file_path as file_path,
            all_graph_resources.directory_path as directory_path,
            all_graph_resources.file_name as file_name,
            all_graph_resources.model_type as model_type,
            all_graph_resources.materialized as materialized,
            all_graph_resources.is_public as is_public,
            all_graph_resources.access as access,
            all_graph_resources.source_name as source_name,
            all_graph_resources.is_excluded as is_excluded,
            case
                when all_graph_resources.resource_type = 'source'
                then null
                when all_graph_resources.resource_type = 'exposure'
                then exposures.direct_parent_id
                when all_graph_resources.resource_type = 'metric'
                then metrics.direct_parent_id
                when all_graph_resources.resource_type in ('model', 'snapshot', 'test')
                then models.direct_parent_id
                else null
            end as direct_parent_id,
            (
                all_graph_resources.resource_type = 'test'
                and models.is_primary_relationship
            ) as is_primary_test_relationship
        from all_graph_resources
        left join
            direct_model_relationships as models
            on all_graph_resources.resource_id = models.resource_id
        left join
            direct_exposure_relationships as exposures
            on all_graph_resources.resource_id = exposures.resource_id
        left join
            direct_metrics_relationships as metrics
            on all_graph_resources.resource_id = metrics.resource_id
    ),

    final as (
        select
            *,
            {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(["resource_id", "direct_parent_id"]) }}
            as unique_id
        from direct_relationships
    )

select *
from final

model.dbt_project_evaluator.int_all_grap.raw_code:
-- one row for each resource in the graph
{# flatten the sets of permissable primary key test sets to one level for later iteration #}
{%- set test_macro_list = [] %}
{%- for test_set in var("primary_key_test_macros") -%}
    {%- for test in test_set %} {%- do test_macro_list.append(test) -%} {%- endfor %}
{%- endfor -%}
{%- do test_macro_list.append("dbt.test_unique") -%}
{%- set test_macro_set = set_strict(test_macro_list) -%}

{%- set quoted_directory_pattern = wrap_string_with_quotes(get_directory_pattern()) %}

with
    unioned as (

        {{
            dbt_utils.union_relations(
                [
                    ref("stg_nodes"),
                    ref("stg_exposures"),
                    ref("stg_metrics"),
                    ref("stg_sources"),
                ]
            )
        }}

    ),

    naming_convention_prefixes as (
        select * from {{ ref("stg_naming_convention_prefixes") }}
    ),

    naming_convention_folders as (
        select * from {{ ref("stg_naming_convention_folders") }}
    ),

    unioned_with_calc as (
        select
            *,
            case
                when resource_type = 'source'
                then {{ dbt.concat(["source_name", "'.'", "name"]) }}
                when coalesce(version, '') != ''
                then {{ dbt.concat(["name", "'.v'", "version"]) }}
                else name
            end as resource_name,
            case
                when resource_type = 'source'
                then null
                else
                    if(
                        {{ dbt.position("'__'", "name") }} > 0,
                        {{ dbt.split_part("name", "'__'", 1) }} || '__',
                        {{ dbt.split_part("name", "'_'", 1) }} || '_'
                    )
            end as prefix,
            {{ get_dbtreplace_directory_pattern() }} as directory_path,
            regexp_replace(
                file_path, '.*{{ get_regexp_directory_pattern() }}', ''
            ) as file_name
        from unioned
        where
            coalesce(is_enabled, True) = True
            and package_name != 'dbt_project_evaluator'
    ),

    joined as (

        select
            unioned_with_calc.unique_id as resource_id,
            unioned_with_calc.resource_name,
            unioned_with_calc.prefix,
            unioned_with_calc.resource_type,
            unioned_with_calc.file_path,
            unioned_with_calc.directory_path,
            unioned_with_calc.is_generic_test,
            unioned_with_calc.file_name,
            case
                when
                    unioned_with_calc.resource_type
                    in ('test', 'source', 'metric', 'exposure', 'seed')
                then null
                else nullif(naming_convention_prefixes.model_type, '')
            end as model_type_prefix,
            case
                when
                    unioned_with_calc.resource_type
                    in ('test', 'source', 'metric', 'exposure', 'seed')
                then null
                when
                    {{
                        dbt.position(
                            dbt.concat(
                                [
                                    quoted_directory_pattern,
                                    "naming_convention_folders.folder_name_value",
                                    quoted_directory_pattern,
                                ]
                            ),
                            "unioned_with_calc.directory_path",
                        )
                    }} = 0
                then null
                else naming_convention_folders.model_type
            end as model_type_folder,
            {{
                dbt.position(
                    dbt.concat(
                        [
                            quoted_directory_pattern,
                            "naming_convention_folders.folder_name_value",
                            quoted_directory_pattern,
                        ]
                    ),
                    "unioned_with_calc.directory_path",
                )
            }} as position_folder,
            nullif(unioned_with_calc.column_name, '') as column_name,
            {% for test in test_macro_set %}
                unioned_with_calc.macro_dependencies like '%macro.{{ test }}%'
                and unioned_with_calc.resource_type
                = 'test' as is_{{ test.split(".")[1] }},
            {% endfor %}
            unioned_with_calc.is_enabled,
            unioned_with_calc.materialized,
            unioned_with_calc.on_schema_change,
            unioned_with_calc.database,
            unioned_with_calc.schema,
            unioned_with_calc.package_name,
            unioned_with_calc.alias,
            unioned_with_calc.is_described,
            unioned_with_calc.model_group,
            unioned_with_calc.access,
            unioned_with_calc.access = 'public' as is_public,
            unioned_with_calc.latest_version,
            unioned_with_calc.version,
            unioned_with_calc.deprecation_date,
            unioned_with_calc.is_contract_enforced,
            unioned_with_calc.total_defined_columns,
            unioned_with_calc.total_described_columns,
            unioned_with_calc.exposure_type,
            unioned_with_calc.maturity,
            unioned_with_calc.url,
            unioned_with_calc.owner_name,
            unioned_with_calc.owner_email,
            unioned_with_calc.meta,
            unioned_with_calc.macro_dependencies,
            unioned_with_calc.metric_type,
            unioned_with_calc.label,
            unioned_with_calc.metric_filter,
            unioned_with_calc.metric_measure,
            unioned_with_calc.metric_measure_alias,
            unioned_with_calc.numerator,
            unioned_with_calc.denominator,
            unioned_with_calc.expr,
            unioned_with_calc.metric_window,
            unioned_with_calc.grain_to_date,
            unioned_with_calc.source_name,  -- NULL for non-source resources
            unioned_with_calc.is_source_described,
            unioned_with_calc.loaded_at_field,
            unioned_with_calc.is_freshness_enabled,
            unioned_with_calc.loader,
            unioned_with_calc.identifier,
            unioned_with_calc.hard_coded_references,  -- NULL for non-model resources
            unioned_with_calc.number_lines,  -- NULL for non-model resources
            unioned_with_calc.sql_complexity,  -- NULL for non-model resources
            unioned_with_calc.is_excluded  -- NULL for metrics and exposures

        from unioned_with_calc
        left join
            naming_convention_prefixes
            on unioned_with_calc.prefix = naming_convention_prefixes.prefix_value

        cross join naming_convention_folders

    ),

    calculate_model_type as (
        select
            *,
            case
                when resource_type in ('test', 'source', 'metric', 'exposure', 'seed')
                then null
                -- by default we will define the model type based on its prefix in the
                -- case prefix and folder types are different
                else coalesce(model_type_prefix, model_type_folder, 'other')
            end as model_type,
            row_number() over (
                partition by resource_id order by position_folder desc
            ) as folder_name_rank
        from joined
    ),

    final as (select * from calculate_model_type where folder_name_rank = 1)

select *
from final

with all_dag_relationships as (
    select  
        *
    from {{ ref('int_all_dag_relationships') }}

        {{ dbt.listagg(

            delimiter_text = "', '", 
            order_by_clause = 'order by child' if target.type in ['snowflake','redshift','duckdb','trino'])

model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_rejoinin.name: fct_rejoining_of_upstream_concepts
model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_rejoinin.description: "All cases where one of the parent's direct children (child) is ALSO the direct child of ANOTHER one of the  parent's direct children (parent_and_child). Only includes cases where the model "in between" the parent and child  has NO other downstream dependencies.
model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_rejoinin.raw_code:
with all_relationships as (
    select  
        *
    from {{ ref('int_all_dag_relationships') }}
    where parent_resource_type not in ('exposure', 'metric')
    and child_resource_type not in ('exposure', 'metric')
    and not parent_is_excluded
    and not child_is_excluded
),

-- all parent/child relationships where the parent is BOTH the direct parent of the child and the second level parent of the child 
rejoined as (
    select
        parent,
        child
    from all_relationships
    group by 1, 2
    having (sum(case when distance = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 1 
        and sum(case when distance = 2 then 1 else 0 end) >= 1)
),

-- resources with only one direct child
single_use_resources as (
    select
        parent
    from all_relationships
    where distance = 1
    group by 1
    having count(*) = 1
),

-- all cases where one of the parent's direct children (child) is ALSO the direct child of ANOTHER one of the parent's direct childen (parent_and_child)
triad_relationships as (
    select 
        rejoined.parent,
        rejoined.child,
        direct_child.parent as parent_and_child
    from rejoined
    left join all_relationships as direct_child
        on rejoined.child = direct_child.child
        and direct_child.distance = 1
    left join all_relationships as direct_parent
        on rejoined.parent = direct_parent.parent
        and direct_parent.distance = 1
    where direct_child.parent = direct_parent.child
),

-- additionally, only includes cases where the model "in between" the parent and parent_and_child has NO other downstream dependencies
-- Note: when the "in between" model DOES have downstream dependencies, it's possible this DAG choice has been made to avoid duplicated code and as such is OKAY
final as (
    select
        triad_relationships.*,
        case 
            when single_use_resources.parent is not null then true 
            else false
        end as is_loop_independent
    from triad_relationships
    left join single_use_resources 
        on triad_relationships.parent_and_child = single_use_resources.parent
),

final_filtered as (
    select * from final
    where is_loop_independent
)

select * from final_filtered

model.dbt_project_evaluator.int_model_te.name: int_model_test_summary
model.dbt_project_evaluator.int_model_te.raw_code:
with 

all_graph_resources as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_all_graph_resources') }}
    where not is_excluded
),

relationships as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_direct_relationships') }}
),

count_column_tests as (
    
    select 
        relationships.direct_parent_id, 
        all_graph_resources.column_name,
        sum(case
                when all_graph_resources.is_test_unique
                then 1
                else 0
            end
         ) as test_unique_count,
        {%- for test_set in var('primary_key_test_macros') %}
            {%- set outer_loop = loop -%}
        count(distinct case when 
                {%- for test in test_set %} 
                all_graph_resources.is_{{ test.split('.')[1] }} {%- if not loop.last %} or {% endif %} 
                {%- endfor %}
            then relationships.resource_id else null end
        ) as primary_key_method_{{ outer_loop.index }}_count,
        {%- endfor %}
        count(distinct relationships.resource_id) as tests_count
    from all_graph_resources
    left join relationships
        on all_graph_resources.resource_id = relationships.resource_id
    where all_graph_resources.resource_type = 'test'
    and relationships.is_primary_test_relationship
    group by 1,2
),

count_column_constraints as (

    select
        node_unique_id as direct_parent_id,
        name as column_name,
        case
            when has_not_null_constraint
            then 1
            else 0
        end as constraint_not_null_count,
        constraints_count
    from {{ ref('base_node_columns') }}

),

combine_column_counts as (

    select
        count_column_tests.*,
        count_column_tests.test_unique_count + count_column_constraints.constraint_not_null_count as primary_key_mixed_method_count,
        count_column_constraints.constraints_count
    from count_column_tests
    left join count_column_constraints
        on count_column_tests.direct_parent_id = count_column_constraints.direct_parent_id
        and count_column_tests.column_name = count_column_constraints.column_name

),

agg_test_relationships as (

    select 
        direct_parent_id, 
        cast(sum(case 
                when (
                    {%- for test_set in var('primary_key_test_macros') %}
                        {%- set compare_value = test_set | length %}
                    primary_key_method_{{ loop.index }}_count >= {{ compare_value}}
                        or
                    {%- endfor %}
                    primary_key_mixed_method_count >= 2
                ) then 1 
                else 0 
            end
        ) >= 1 as {{ dbt.type_boolean() }}) as is_primary_key_tested,
        cast(sum(tests_count) as {{ dbt.type_int()}}) as number_of_tests_on_model,
        cast(sum(constraints_count) as {{ dbt.type_int()}}) as number_of_constraints_on_model
    from combine_column_counts
    group by 1

),

final as (
    select 
        all_graph_resources.resource_name,
        all_graph_resources.resource_type,
        all_graph_resources.model_type,
        cast(coalesce(agg_test_relationships.is_primary_key_tested, FALSE) as {{ dbt.type_boolean()}}) as is_primary_key_tested,
        cast(coalesce(agg_test_relationships.number_of_tests_on_model, 0) as {{ dbt.type_int()}}) as number_of_tests_on_model,
        cast(coalesce(agg_test_relationships.number_of_constraints_on_model, 0) as {{ dbt.type_int()}}) as number_of_constraints_on_model
    from all_graph_resources
    left join agg_test_relationships
        on all_graph_resources.resource_id = agg_test_relationships.direct_parent_id
    where
        all_graph_resources.resource_type in ('model', 'seed', 'source', 'snapshot')
)

select * from final

model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_model_na.name: fct_model_naming_conventions
model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_model_na.description: This finds all cases where a model does NOT have the appropriate prefix.
model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_model_na.raw_code:
-- all models with inappropriate (or lack of) pre-fix
-- ensure dbt project has consistent naming conventions
with
    all_graph_resources as (
        select *
        from {{ ref("int_all_graph_resources") }}
        where
            not is_excluded
            -- exclude required metricflow time spine
            and resource_name != 'metricflow_time_spine'
    ),

    naming_convention_prefixes as (
        select *
        from {{ ref("stg_naming_convention_prefixes") }}
        -- we order the CTE so that listagg returns values correctly sorted for some
        -- warehouses
        order by prefix_value
    ),

    appropriate_prefixes as (
        select
            model_type,
            {{ dbt.listagg(
            measure='prefix_value', 
            delimiter_text="', '", 
            order_by_clause='order by prefix_value' if target.type in ['snowflake','redshift','duckdb','trino'])
        }}
            as appropriate_prefixes
        from naming_convention_prefixes
        group by model_type
    ),

    models as (
        select
            all_graph_resources.resource_name,
            all_graph_resources.prefix,
            all_graph_resources.model_type,
            naming_convention_prefixes.prefix_value
        from all_graph_resources
        left join
            naming_convention_prefixes
            on all_graph_resources.model_type = naming_convention_prefixes.model_type
            and all_graph_resources.prefix = naming_convention_prefixes.prefix_value
        where resource_type = 'model'
    ),

    inappropriate_model_names as (
        select
            models.resource_name,
            models.prefix,
            models.model_type,
            appropriate_prefixes.appropriate_prefixes
        from models
        left join
            appropriate_prefixes on models.model_type = appropriate_prefixes.model_type
        where
            nullif(models.prefix_value, '') is null
            and appropriate_prefixes.appropriate_prefixes != ''

    )

select *
from inappropriate_model_names {{ filter_exceptions() }}

model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_model_di.raw_code:
-- This model finds all cases where a model is NOT in the appropriate subdirectory:
    -- For staging models: The files should be in nested in the staging folder in a subfolder that matches their source parent's name.
    -- For non-staging models: The files should be nested closest to their appropriate folder.  
{% set directory_pattern = get_directory_pattern() %}
 
with all_graph_resources as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_all_graph_resources') }}
    where not is_excluded
),

folders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_naming_convention_folders') }}
), 

all_dag_relationships as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_all_dag_relationships') }}
    where not child_is_excluded
),

staging_models as (
    select  
        child,
        child_resource_type,
        child_model_type,
        child_file_path,
        child_directory_path,
        child_file_name,
        parent_source_name
    from all_dag_relationships
    where parent_resource_type = 'source'
    and child_resource_type = 'model'
    and child_model_type = 'staging'
),

-- find all staging models that are NOT in their source parent's subdirectory
inappropriate_subdirectories_staging as (
    select distinct -- must do distinct to avoid duplicates when staging model has multiple paths to a given source
        child as resource_name,
        child_resource_type as resource_type,
        child_model_type as model_type,
        child_file_path as current_file_path,
        'models{{ directory_pattern }}' || '{{ var("staging_folder_name") }}' || '{{ directory_pattern }}' || parent_source_name || '{{ directory_pattern }}' || child_file_name as change_file_path_to
    from staging_models
    where child_directory_path not like '%' || parent_source_name || '%'
),

-- find all non-staging models that are NOT nested closest to their appropriate folder
innappropriate_subdirectories_non_staging_models as (
    select 
        all_graph_resources.resource_name,
        all_graph_resources.resource_type,
        all_graph_resources.model_type,
        all_graph_resources.file_path as current_file_path,
        'models' || '{{ directory_pattern }}...{{ directory_pattern }}' || folders.folder_name_value || '{{ directory_pattern }}...{{ directory_pattern }}' || all_graph_resources.file_name as change_file_path_to
    from all_graph_resources
    left join folders 
        on folders.model_type = all_graph_resources.model_type 
    -- either appropriate folder_name is not in the current_directory_path or a inappropriate folder name is closer to the file_name
    where all_graph_resources.model_type <> all_graph_resources.model_type_folder 
),

unioned as (
    select * from inappropriate_subdirectories_staging
    union all
    select * from innappropriate_subdirectories_non_staging_models
)

select * from unioned

{{ filter_exceptions() }}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.name: _bigquery__get_table_shards_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_table_shards_sql(information_schema) %}
    select
        tables.project_id as table_catalog,
        tables.dataset_id as table_schema,
        coalesce(REGEXP_EXTRACT(tables.table_id, '^(.+)[0-9]{8}$'), tables.table_id) as table_name,
        tables.table_id as shard_name,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(tables.table_id, '^.+([0-9]{8})$') as shard_index,
        REGEXP_CONTAINS(tables.table_id, '^.+[0-9]{8}$') and tables.type = 1 as is_date_shard,
        case
            when materialized_views.table_name is not null then 'materialized view'
            when tables.type = 1 then 'table'
            when tables.type = 2 then 'view'
            else 'external'
        end as table_type,
        tables.type = 1 as is_table,
        JSON_VALUE(table_description.option_value) as table_comment,
        tables.size_bytes,
        tables.row_count
    from {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='__TABLES__') }} tables
    left join {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='MATERIALIZED_VIEWS') }} materialized_views
        on materialized_views.table_catalog = tables.project_id
        and materialized_views.table_schema = tables.dataset_id
        and materialized_views.table_name = tables.table_id
    left join {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='TABLE_OPTIONS') }} table_description
        on table_description.table_catalog = tables.project_id
        and table_description.table_schema = tables.dataset_id
        and table_description.table_name = tables.table_id
        and table_description.option_name = 'description'
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.name: _bigquery__get_table_stats_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_table_stats_sql() %}
    select
        table_catalog,
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        max(shard_name) as latest_shard_name,
        min(shard_index) as shard_min,
        max(shard_index) as shard_max,
        count(shard_index) as shard_count,
        sum(size_bytes) as size_bytes,
        sum(row_count) as row_count
    from table_shards
    group by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.name: _bigquery__get_columns_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_columns_sql(information_schema) %}
    select
        columns.table_catalog,
        columns.table_schema,
        columns.table_name as shard_name,
        coalesce(paths.field_path, '<unknown>') as column_name,
        -- invent a row number to account for nested fields
        -- BQ does not treat these nested properties as independent fields
        row_number() over (
            partition by
                columns.table_catalog,
                columns.table_schema,
                columns.table_name
            order by
                columns.ordinal_position,
                paths.field_path
        ) as column_index,
        coalesce(paths.data_type, '<unknown>') as column_type,
        paths.description as column_comment,
        case when columns.is_partitioning_column = 'YES' then 1 else 0 end as is_partitioning_column,
        case when columns.is_partitioning_column = 'YES' then paths.field_path end as partition_column,
        case when columns.clustering_ordinal_position is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_clustering_column,
        case when columns.clustering_ordinal_position is not null then paths.field_path end as cluster_column,
        columns.clustering_ordinal_position
    from {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='COLUMNS') }} columns
    join {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS') }} paths
        on paths.table_catalog = columns.table_catalog
        and paths.table_schema = columns.table_schema
        and paths.table_name = columns.table_name
        and paths.column_name = columns.column_name
    where columns.ordinal_position is not null
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.name: _bigquery__get_column_stats_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_column_stats_sql() %}
    select
        table_catalog,
        table_schema,
        shard_name,
        max(is_partitioning_column) = 1 as is_partitioned,
        max(partition_column) as partition_column,
        max(is_clustering_column) = 1 as is_clustered,
        array_to_string(
            array_agg(
                cluster_column ignore nulls
                order by clustering_ordinal_position
            ), ', '
        ) as clustering_columns
    from columns
    group by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_extend.name: _bigquery__get_extended_catalog_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_extend.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_extended_catalog_sql() %}
    select
        tables.table_catalog as table_database,
        tables.table_schema,
        case
            when tables.is_date_shard then concat(tables.table_name, '*')
            else tables.table_name
        end as table_name,
        tables.table_type,
        tables.table_comment,
        -- coalesce column metadata fields to ensure they are non-null for catalog generation
        -- external table columns are not present in COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS
        coalesce(columns.column_name, '<unknown>') as column_name,
        coalesce(columns.column_index, 1) as column_index,
        coalesce(columns.column_type, '<unknown>') as column_type,
        coalesce(columns.column_comment, '') as column_comment,

        'Shard count' as `stats__date_shards__label`,
        table_stats.shard_count as `stats__date_shards__value`,
        'The number of date shards in this table' as `stats__date_shards__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shards__include`,

        'Shard (min)' as `stats__date_shard_min__label`,
        table_stats.shard_min as `stats__date_shard_min__value`,
        'The first date shard in this table' as `stats__date_shard_min__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shard_min__include`,

        'Shard (max)' as `stats__date_shard_max__label`,
        table_stats.shard_max as `stats__date_shard_max__value`,
        'The last date shard in this table' as `stats__date_shard_max__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shard_max__include`,

        '# Rows' as `stats__num_rows__label`,
        table_stats.row_count as `stats__num_rows__value`,
        'Approximate count of rows in this table' as `stats__num_rows__description`,
        tables.is_table as `stats__num_rows__include`,

        'Approximate Size' as `stats__num_bytes__label`,
        table_stats.size_bytes as `stats__num_bytes__value`,
        'Approximate size of table as reported by BigQuery' as `stats__num_bytes__description`,
        tables.is_table as `stats__num_bytes__include`,

        'Partitioned By' as `stats__partitioning_type__label`,
        column_stats.partition_column as `stats__partitioning_type__value`,
        'The partitioning column for this table' as `stats__partitioning_type__description`,
        column_stats.is_partitioned as `stats__partitioning_type__include`,

        'Clustered By' as `stats__clustering_fields__label`,
        column_stats.clustering_columns as `stats__clustering_fields__value`,
        'The clustering columns for this table' as `stats__clustering_fields__description`,
        column_stats.is_clustered as `stats__clustering_fields__include`

    from tables
    join table_stats
        on table_stats.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and table_stats.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and table_stats.table_name = tables.table_name
    left join column_stats
        on column_stats.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and column_stats.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and column_stats.shard_name = table_stats.latest_shard_name
    left join columns
        on columns.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and columns.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and columns.shard_name = table_stats.latest_shard_name
{% endmacro %}
